answer: A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ember counter is kept in thread and opal reveals each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 41 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
